title: Renndo ƴaañorgal gadanal
intro: E nder leydi gure ɓooyɗe, leñol meeɗiino ƴellitaade. Ɓe njilliima nelaaɗo e noddaango laaɓngo, tee ɓe mbayliima, ɓe ndewi laawol ngol hay gooto meeɗaa yahde. Haala maɓɓe ko ƴattooje, majjere, e jukkungo ngo acci leydi maɓɓe ko maande wonande miijotooɓe fof. Hol ɓeeɗoo ruuhuuji?
clues: Min nguuri ko e gure ladde, ɗo annabi amen noddi min e peewal.
Ko min adii waɗde fenaande nde hay gooto e adunaaji ɗii fof meeɗaa waɗde.
Min waylaid yahooɓe min mbaɗi bonanndeeji e peeñcu e nder mooɓondiral amen.
En njaɓaani nelaaɗo nelaaɗo e men, en ndaranii ɗum riiwtude ɗum e leydi men.
Min ndogi min payi to galle makko min ɗaɓɓi nde o rokkata min hoɓɓe makko.
Jukkungo men ko toɓo kaaƴe, wuro men waylitii.
verse: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. (26:162)
